in_urdu.name: Nujaim
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Victorious
in_urdu.long_meaning: Nujaim ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ Derived from the Arabic root 'n-j-m' which means 'to defeat' or 'to overcome'. Named for those who have triumphed over adversity and achieved victory in their lives.

in_hindi.name: Nujaim
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लामी नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious

in_pashto.name: Nujaim
in_pashto.meaning: اسلامي نوم چې معنی یې ده Victorious
